status: The full coast-central-north loop cannot meet all supplied time and driving limits. This published route is the compliant coast-central version; the north option is a constraint-change branch.

days.afternoon: 15:15–15:30 effective road start after bags and rental desk. Inspect the car and test all four bags under the closed parcel shelf. Check in at a Tivat or Porto Montenegro hotel before any walk.
days.evening: Easy waterfront dinner in Porto Montenegro; sunset stroll by the marina. Keep the first night gentle after travel.
days.parking: Hotel lot or guarded hotel parking. Never leave the cases in the vehicle.

days.morning: Breakfast, then drive to Kotor. Check in or leave the car in a guarded hotel lot and unload before visiting town.
days.afternoon: Kotor Old Town, Maritime Museum lanes and the city walls. The municipality’s October wall hours end at 17:00; start the climb early and turn back if weather or footing is poor.
days.evening: Seafood dinner in the old town, then a quiet walk along the waterfront.
days.parking: Hotel lot preferred; otherwise use the marked Kotor public parking outside the Old Town. Do not enter narrow old-town lanes.
days.cash: Carry €15/person for the wall fee; verify current ticket price at the gate.

days.drive: Kotor → Lovćen → Cetinje · 1h30–2h wheel time; reserve 2h30 including terrain buffer
days.morning: Check out and drive the Kotor serpentine to Lovćen National Park. Keep the high road in daylight; pause at the marked viewpoints only where safe.
days.afternoon: Short, weather-permitting walk around Ivanova Korita and the visitor-center area. Continue to Cetinje, check in and park before exploring the historic center.
days.evening: Montenegrin dinner in Cetinje: kačamak or Njeguši cheese/prosciutto; ask the restaurant to confirm availability.
days.parking: Use signed Lovćen visitor parking; in Cetinje use hotel or marked public parking. Bags stay locked away at lodging during the park visit.
days.cash: €3/person park budget; bring cash for rural cafés and parking.

days.drive: Cetinje → Virpazar · about 1h20; allow 1h45 with terrain buffer
days.morning: Drive to Virpazar and check in first. Book a 10:30–12:30 shared Lake Skadar boat trip with an operator that confirms the October departure and weather policy.
days.afternoon: Lake Skadar National Park boat outing and lakeside lunch. Return to lodging before dusk; keep a short village walk as the weather fallback.
days.evening: Dinner in Virpazar with local lake fish and Vranac wine. Driver abstains if driving later.
days.parking: Use accommodation or marked Virpazar parking after unloading. Boats depart from the village waterfront.
days.cash: Carry €50/person combined park/boat allowance in small notes; ask operator whether card is accepted.

days.drive: Virpazar → Tivat · about 1h45–2h via Sozina; allow 2h30
days.morning: Check out and head to Tivat. Sozina tunnel passenger-car toll is €2.50 each way; cash and card are reported accepted. Check in and unload before leaving the car.
days.afternoon: Regent Porto Montenegro spa: reserve day access and treatments directly; nonresident access and rates are not published. If unavailable, take an easy Tivat waterfront walk.
days.evening: Last-night dinner by the marina; confirm the airport car return procedure and fuel policy with the rental desk.
days.parking: Hotel parking; no luggage left in the vehicle. Confirm guarded parking when booking.
days.cash: Hold €10 for the tunnel/tips; card is usually accepted at formal venues.

days.drive: Tivat hotel → TIV · 10–20 min; arrive terminal by 12:15
days.morning: 08:30–09:30 breakfast or a short walk within Tivat. 09:30 depart, refuel if required, return car by 11:30 and reach terminal by 12:15 for the 14:55 flight.
days.parking: No sightseeing detours. Allow 30–45 min for car return, inspection and shuttle/walk; rental desk instructions take precedence.
days.cash: Keep card and rental deposit documentation accessible.

alpineBranch.title: Northern Alpine inclusion option (not constraint-compliant)

days.morning: Leave coast early for Nikšić, then continue to Žabljak only if live routing plus the 20% terrain uplift remains at or under 3.5 h. Published mapping ranges make this threshold uncertain; lodge after arrival.
days.afternoon: Black Lake short loop only if reached with daylight margin; otherwise move the hike to next morning.
days.evening: Žabljak guesthouse dinner; confirm heating and parking.

days.morning: Check AMSCG, 112 MNE and local host for P14/Sedlo, frost, wind and trail condition. Skip P14 if any uncertainty; Black Lake walk is the lower-risk alternative.
days.afternoon: Return toward Nikšić before the daylight cutoff. The combined local driving plus transfer may exceed 3.5 h once terrain uplift is applied.
days.evening: Nikšić overnight to split the return; no bridge crossing at Đurđevića Tara.

days.morning: Nikšić to Tivat, direct, with a buffer for roadworks.
days.afternoon: Check in and unload by mid-afternoon; optional spa/waterfront.
days.evening: Tivat overnight keeps Day 6 within the airport radius. The branch still has not added a meaningful Lake Skadar visit.

alpineBranch.decision: This option does not pass the user’s hard driving ceiling reliably. Add a day or relax the daily limit before booking an alpine overnight. The compliant Coast + Central route above is also the full fallback if northern roads are compromised.

guardrails.name: Driving ceiling, adjusted route
guardrails.detail: Plan day maxima: 2.5 h. Confirm actual door-to-door route each morning; congestion can add time.

guardrails.name: Mountain / boat daylight margin
guardrails.detail: Lovćen road and boat trip are scheduled to finish by 16:00; stop earlier if weather or twilight changes.

guardrails.name: Luggage concealment
guardrails.detail: All transfer-day plans check in or unload before excursions; vehicle class must be physically tested.

guardrails.name: Day 6 airport radius and 12:15 terminal
guardrails.detail: Tivat overnight; depart by 09:30 and return rental by 11:30.

guardrails.name: All three regions within the 3.5 h/day ceiling
guardrails.detail: North / Durmitor cannot be added with confidence and meet the return-to-TIV deadline in five nights.

guardrails.name: Đurđevića Tara Bridge route availability
guardrails.detail: Closed across the trip dates through Oct 26, 2026. Do not route over it.
